origin.description: Integers from imin to imax, inclusive.
origin.details: Shape 3 by 4 and 1 when every entry is an integer from 2 to 5.
origin.value: Integers from imin to imax, inclusive.
origin.example: { x <- randi(c(2, 5), 3, 4); c(dim(x), as.numeric(all(x >= 2 & x <= 5 & x == floor(x)))) }

translation.description: Integers from imin to imax, inclusive.
translation.details: Shape 3 by 4 and 1 when every entry is an integer from 2 to 5.
translation.value: Integers from imin to imax, inclusive.
translation.example: (lambda x=randi([2, 5], 3, 4): np.concatenate([np.array(x.shape, float), [1.0 if np.all((x >= 2) & (x <= 5) & (x == np.floor(x))) else 0.0]]))()
